question: Is design-exhaustive supervision the source of the gain: does held-out error fall as each training chemical contributes more of its sparse designs?
model: frozen AnchorBoost features and hyperparameters (chip_forecast.py); only the number of training designs per chemical changes

code.flag: --train-designs N (seeded random N of the C(L,3) designs per chemical)

arms.published5: the five published context designs (prior ablation, 1.183)

metric: curve error, paired chemical bootstrap against the every-design model

forecast.monotone: error decreases from 5 to 10 to 20 to all designs

context: Seven other mechanisms changed development-fold error by at most 0.003 (see chip_forecast_selfcheck_protocol.json development_log and the replay options); this curve tests the one mechanism whose ablation already excluded zero.
